name: dev.knowapi/data
title: KnowAPI
description: No API? KnowAPI: verified, cited public data for AI agents, and any missing data built on request.

tools.name: watch_check
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether something they own or rely on has a problem right now: a product (barcode or description) or car (VIN or make/model/year) recalled, a medicine (NDC or name) in FDA shortage or recalled, their flight's airports under FAA ground stops/closures/delays, what is happening near a location (power outages, NWS warnings, earthquakes, disaster declarations), undeclared-allergen food recalls (allergy), tire age and recalls from a DOT code (tire), or actively exploited flaws for a device (device), expiry and recalls for a car seat, smoke alarm, CO alarm or fire extinguisher (safety: type, made, brand, model), or recalls for a home appliance by brand and model number (appliance), pet food and pet medicine recalls (pet), data breaches reported by companies they use (breach), or drinking water violations for their water system (water). Flight checks cover airport-wide disruptions, not the status of a single flight. Medicines also return what pharmacies pay (NADAC) and expiry/lot checks. Returns alert/watch/clear with official sources.

companies.description: breach: companies you use, comma separated.

type.description: safety: car_seat, smoke_alarm, co_alarm or extinguisher; appliance: what it is (dryer, heater...).

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: check_product_recall
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether a product, food, drug, medical device, toy, car or car part was recalled in the US, or scans a barcode. Give ONE of: upc (barcode digits), model (+ optional brand), ndc (drug code), query (free text like "listeria cheese"), or vehicle_make + vehicle_model + vehicle_year. Searches CPSC, FDA, USDA and NHTSA and links each official recall. "No match" is not proof an item is safe.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: drug_shortages
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether a medicine is in shortage or hard to get in the US, or which drugs are short right now. Returns FDA drug shortage records (drug, company, status, availability, last update) with the official source.

drug.description: Drug name, generic or brand (optional; leave out for the latest shortages).

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: power_outages
tools.description: Use when the user asks about power outages or blackouts in the US right now: where, how many customers are out, which utility, estimated restoration. Filter by state and/or utility. Live, by county.

utility.description: Utility name or part of it.

min_customers_out.description: Only counties with at least this many customers out.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: recent_earthquakes
tools.description: Use when the user asks about earthquakes in the past day anywhere in the world or the US: where, magnitude, time, tsunami flag. Filter by place and minimum magnitude.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: weather_alerts
tools.description: Use when the user asks about weather warnings, watches or advisories (storms, floods, heat, winter, fire weather) for a US place right now. Give lat + lon for a point, or a 2-letter state code; nothing returns the most severe alerts nationwide. "No active alerts" is not a forecast.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: find_nursing_homes
tools.description: Use when the user asks about nursing homes or skilled nursing facilities in the US: star ratings, penalties, ownership, location. Filter by state, city, name and minimum overall rating.

name.description: Facility name or part of it.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: find_hospitals
tools.description: Use when the user asks about US hospitals: CMS star rating, type, ownership, emergency services, address. Filter by state, city and name.

name.description: Hospital name or part of it.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: drug_acquisition_price
tools.description: Use when the user asks what a generic or brand drug costs pharmacies in the US (price per unit, e.g. per tablet). CMS National Average Drug Acquisition Cost, by drug name or NDC.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: airport_delays
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether a US airport has delays, a ground stop or a closure right now. Live from the FAA. Give the airport code (e.g. SFO) or leave it out for all current delays.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: company_8k_filings
tools.description: Use when the user asks about recent material events at a US public company (8-K filings: executive changes, acquisitions, earnings, bankruptcies, cyber incidents). Filter by company name and date.

company.description: Company name or part of it.

since.description: Only filings on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: exploited_vulnerabilities
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether a software product has known exploited vulnerabilities, or for the latest actively exploited CVEs (CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities, with ransomware use and required action).

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: border_wait_times
tools.description: Use when the user asks how long the wait is at a US land border crossing (Canada or Mexico) for cars, trucks or pedestrians. Filter by port name or border.

port.description: Port or crossing name, e.g. "San Ysidro".

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: gov_contract_opportunities
tools.description: Use when the user asks about government contracts, bids, RFPs, solicitations or sources-sought notices they could win: new US federal contract opportunities by keyword, NAICS code, state and set-aside (small business, 8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB, HUBZone). Returns title, agency, NAICS, set-aside, place of performance, posted date and response deadline.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: disaster_declarations
tools.description: Use when the user asks about federal disaster or emergency declarations in the US (hurricanes, floods, fires, storms) by state, type or date.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: treasury_yields
tools.description: Use when the user asks for US Treasury yields or rates (1-month to 30-year), today or for recent days.

since.description: From this date (YYYY-MM-DD); leave out for the latest days.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 calls free within 48 hours).

tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Find live public-data APIs. Example: search_apis({query:"drug shortage"}) -> api_id, fields, filters and 3 real sample records. Leave query empty to list all (recalls, power outages, earthquakes, weather, FDA, SEC filings, electricity prices, nursing homes, sanctions...). If nothing matches, we offer to build it (free trial).

query.description: Optional search text, e.g. "recall" or "drug shortage".

notify_url.description: Optional public https webhook: if nothing matches we build it and POST a signed api_ready message when it is live.

tools.name: get_api_key
tools.description: Optional: query_api creates a free key for you. Use this to get one up front. Keys are per API; your first 15 calls are free within 48 hours (shared by all your keys).

tools.name: query_api
tools.description: Get data from an API. Example: query_api({api_id:"<from search_apis>", params:{state:"CA", limit:10}}). api_key is optional: without one, a free key is created and returned. Up to 50 records per call; every answer has the official source, read time and coverage.

api_key.description: Optional. Key from an earlier call or get_api_key; omit to get a free one.

tools.name: request_data
tools.description: Create your own API from any public data. Example: request_data({description:"Daily FDA drug recalls for pet food with brand and reason"}). Describe data you need (10-500 characters). Free: we research public sources, build a trial and test it on real data (5 to 10 minutes). check_request then shows stage trial with a trial api_key: try it free (15 calls, 48 hours) with query_api. Keep it for $3 (returned as usage credit; free with a monthly plan) via authorize_build (poll check_request every couple of minutes). If it takes longer, the status says so and may offer alternatives that can be built right away. The request is listed publicly.

description.description: What data, for where, how fresh. E.g. "Daily list of FDA drug shortages with status and company".

notify_url.description: Optional public https webhook: we POST a signed api_ready message the moment the API is built, so you do not need to poll.

tools.name: check_request
tools.description: Status of a request from request_data (a new API usually takes 5 to 10 minutes; poll every couple of minutes). stage is researching, building, ready (builds[] has the api_id to query), or in_progress (we are still building it; check back later). in_progress may list alternatives that can be built right away.

tools.name: export_dataset
tools.description: Download every record of a dataset API (up to 3,000) as JSON in one go. Offered on datasets with more than 50 records; priced like a call returning that many records (see options.full_export), paid from the key's credit. Without enough credit it returns the price and how to pay (x402 at full_export_url, or add credit).

api_key.description: Key from get_api_key.

tools.name: create_alert
tools.description: Get told when new records matching your filters appear in a dataset API (e.g. new recalls for a brand, new outages in a county). Checks after every refresh of the source; charged one call price per delivery (up to 50 new records), from the key's free calls or credit. Without webhook_url, deliveries wait in an inbox: read them with check_alerts.

api_key.description: Key from get_api_key for this API.

params.description: Filters, same as query parameters, e.g. {"state":"CA"}.

webhook_url.description: Optional public https URL to receive signed POSTs.

tools.name: check_alerts
tools.description: New records delivered by your alerts since the last check (marked as read). Use the same key you created the alerts with.

tools.name: screen_entity
tools.description: Use when the user asks whether a company or person is sanctioned, blocked, debarred or excluded, or wants a KYC/vendor/export check. Checks a company or person against US sanctions (OFAC SDN and other Treasury lists), Commerce BIS Entity/Denied/Unverified lists, State Department ITAR and nonproliferation lists, and the HHS OIG healthcare exclusion list. Returns strong/possible matches with the official source of each, and which lists were checked when. Needs a key for the screening API (get_api_key with its api_id from search_apis "compliance"); $0.10 per check after free checks, or included in a monthly plan.

api_key.description: Optional; leave it out and a free key is created (first 15 checks free within 48 hours).

tools.name: authorize_build
tools.description: When check_request shows stage trial (or trial_ended), keeping the API costs $3 and comes back as $3 of usage credit on it; it becomes permanent and public, and your trial key keeps working. Free with a monthly plan build. With a key this pays from its credit (or uses a plan build). Without a key, POST the authorize_url from check_request and pay the 402 with an x402 client (held up to 30 minutes, settled only if built).

api_key.description: Any of your keys (its credit or your account balance pays; plan builds are used first).

tools.name: get_plans
tools.description: Pricing for a directory API: the price per call after the free calls (shared across all your keys), and the add-ons available for this feed with their prices (per call when used, or per export). No subscription: pay per call from prepaid credit on your key, or with x402 when a call returns 402. Monthly plans (compliance checks + data calls + monitored names): GET /v1/plans, buy with POST /v1/plans/buy?plan=starter|pro|business and your key. Cheapest for agents: top up a key once with x402 (POST /v1/credits/topup?usd=1, 5 or 20 with the key) and calls draw from that credit.
